thread:
Lina: Tiny poll: if you could send one song postcard to a coworker (no notes, just a song link), who gets what? quick picks welcome.
Marcus: @Lina I send @Priya 'Heroes' by David Bowie because it's dramatic and unearned confidence.
Priya: Haha perfect. I would send @Evan 'I Want to Break Free' because it's both a mood and a metaphor. :mtg:
Evan: I would pick 'September' by Earth, Wind & Fire for literally everyone. Instant mood repair.
Lina: Team consensus: 1) Bowie 2) Earth, Wind & Fire 3) Bonobo - Cirrus for chill vibes.
Marcus: Also, who has the weirdest guilty pleasure? I confess to listening to bubblegum pop when writing docs.
Priya: Not weird, efficient. My guilty pleasure is 80s power ballads for late-night bug hunting.
Evan: I curated a "studio warm-up" playlist for anyone who wants it. @Botty can you drop the link?
Botty: Shared playlist "desk-postcards" with #random. Link: https://redwood.example/playlist/desk-postcards :robot_face
Lina: Love it. This is my official new onboarding ritual: song postcard for new hires. Low friction, high personality.
Marcus: Agreed. New hire welcome kit now includes a song postcard and a sticker.
Priya: If anyone wants a physical postcard with lyrics printed, I'll volunteer to design a retro template.
Evan: Please do. I'll mail them out for the first cohort.
Lina: That's wholesome. Closing poll: digital-only or printed postcards? React with :email: for digital, :postal_horn: for printed.
(quick reactions roll in)
Lina: Printed wins by a hair. OK team, we'll prototype for the next new hire.
